Dear Jim,
Life in the M.A. is hard but it is a good experience. Every day I wake up at 6:00 and I put on my uniform. Then I form up with my platoon in the formation area and we go to the mess hall for breakfast. In the morning I usually have classes in the classroom. After lunch we do PT in the gym or we practice for ceremonies. I have free time on Saturday afternoon, so I play football with my friends or I call my family. At night I study in the library and I go to bed at 10 pm.
Take care,
CDT [NAME]

texto: I see a lot of tourists in Santiago, especially in the city centre, and sometimes I help them when they are lost. In my opinion, Santiago is not the best city for tourists. It is large, crowded and more stressful than other cities, but it has interesting museums and famous landmarks. I recommend Valparaíso. Valparaíso is smaller and more colourful than Santiago, and it is near the sea. You can go on a sightseeing tour, take pictures of the hills and try the local food. It is not as expensive as Santiago and the people are very friendly. For me, Valparaíso is the most beautiful city in Chile.
